summary: Added a "watcher stopped" state so a tracker that started and then died reads correctly instead of as "Not watching". In web/src/lib/home.ts I added WATCHER_STOPPED_SENTENCE, watcherCallout(live) (stopped checked before not-watching, null for undefined), and the LiveState type plus liveState(input) with down/stopped/match/watching/idle precedence. LiveStatus.tsx now uses liveState with watcherStopped from live.data?.watcher_stopped, adds 'Watcher stopped' words and a bg-warn dot, and shows WATCHER_STOPPED_SENTENCE in the panel when stopped. CurrentMatchView.tsx's no-match callout uses watcherCallout(live.data), and the opening-hand, intermission and in-progress-match branches each lead with the warn watcher-stopped callout. FirstRun.tsx's STEPS is now a function of live whose first step's detail is watcherCallout(live) ?? NOT_WATCHING_SENTENCE.
concerns: pnpm --dir web test, tsc -b and lint all exit 0; only web/src files under the allowed list changed
The stopped sentence is duplicated verbatim in LiveStatus's panel rather than read from lib, matching the file's existing inline not-watching paragraph
Callout is rendered inside a shrink-0 div in each branch, as specified; in the down (isError) case the pill says 'Tracker not running', untouched
